name: Floating task preview in compact sidebar
description:
Here's a 5-line summary:

1. The user requested that hovering over a sidebar chat node should display a floating detailed information panel.
2. A shared `ChatNodeHoverPanel.vue` component was created to show chat details (name, description, mode, message count, subtask count, and action buttons).
3. `ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue` was updated to show the hover panel to the right using CSS `group`/`group-hover` Tailwind classes with `left-full` positioning.
4. `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` was created/updated to include the same hover panel behavior plus inline action buttons and recursive children rendering.
5. The solution uses CSS-only hover interactions (no JavaScript state) with a consistent shared panel component for both compact and extended sidebar modes.

messages.content: Collapsed mode must show all tasks and on the hover expand them "floating"

I'll update both files to implement a floating expanded view when hovering over tasks in collapsed mode. ## Changes Summary | File | Changes | |------|---------| | `ChatSidebar.vue` | Add floating container for expanded nodes in compact mode; modify hierarchy tree rendering | | `ChatSidebarNode.vue` | Add floating popup logic; show full content on hover in compact mode; add positioning styles | ## Updated Files ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebar.vue ``` ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue ``` ## Key Changes **ChatSidebar.vue:** - Changed compact mode tree container to display items in a column (`flex flex-col items-center`) - Removed condition check for `isCompact` on root chat button content **ChatSidebarNode.vue:** - Added compact mode UI with icon-only display - Implemented floating popup that appears on hover in compact mode - Floating popup positioned relative to the hovered node with full content and actions - Children can be expanded within the floating view - Uses `mouseenter/mouseleave` events with timeout for smooth hover behavior - Floating popup positioned `left-20` to appear next to the sidebar

The floating infor must be shown always on hover when compact and extended.
Make it big so all details can be read

I'll update the `ChatSidebarNode.vue` to show a larger floating popup on hover that's always visible in both compact and expanded modes. ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue ``` ## Changes Summary | Change | Details | |--------|---------| | **Floating Popup Visibility** | Now shows on hover for both compact AND expanded modes (removed conditional `isCompact` check) | | **Popup Size** | Increased from `w-56` to `w-80` with `max-h-screen` for larger display | | **Popup Position** | Added smart vertical positioning to prevent floating off-screen, positioned `16px` to the right of element | | **Content Expansion** | Added more readable spacing with larger fonts (base → sm/md sizes) | | **Mode Information** | Added chat mode display in a highlighted box | | **Subtasks Header** | Added "Subtasks" label when children are expanded | | **Button Sizing** | Upgraded button sizes from `btn-xs` to `btn-sm` for better readability | | **Hover Handlers** | Simplified by moving handlers to parent div; removed event listener mounting logic | | **Spacing** | Increased padding and gaps throughout popup for better visual hierarchy | The floating popup now provides a comprehensive preview that's always accessible on hover, with larger text and more breathing room for readability.
Detail data is floating far away from the sidebar

I'll fix the floating popup positioning to appear closer to the sidebar and be more readable. ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue ``` ## Changes Summary | Change | Details | |--------|---------| | **Popup Width** | Reduced from `w-80` to `w-72` for closer proximity to sidebar | | **Popup Max Height** | Changed from `max-h-screen` to `max-h-96` to keep it compact | | **Gap from Sidebar** | Reduced from `16` to `8` pixels (closer to sidebar) | | **Vertical Positioning** | Centered popup relative to hovered element instead of top-aligned | | **Viewport Safety** | Improved bounds checking to prevent overflow at screen edges with 16px padding | | **Subtasks Section** | Added `max-h-40 overflow-y-auto` to prevent popup from becoming too tall | | **Spacing** | Reduced internal spacing (`space-y-3` → `space-y-3`, `space-y-4` → `space-y-3`) | | **Text Icons** | Added emoji/icon to message count for better visual clarity | | **Button Text Size** | Added `text-xs` for consistency with compact design | The popup now appears much closer to the sidebar and is better positioned vertically for readability.
Floating chat detail is shown sooo far await from the cursor

Looking at the `handleMouseEnter` method, the floating popup is positioned at `rect.right + 8` which places it at the right edge of the sidebar plus 8px. In compact mode, this should be fine, but the issue might be that the popup appears too far right due to viewport calculations or the element's bounding rect. The fix is to position the popup closer to the cursor using the mouse event coordinates instead of the element's bounding rect right edge. ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue ``` ### Changes made | Area | Before | After | |------|--------|--------| | `handleMouseEnter` - clear timeout | Not cleared on re-enter | `clearTimeout` called to prevent stale close | | `floatingTop` | Centered vertically relative to element | Aligned to element's `rect.top` (less jumping) | | `floatingLeft` | `rect.right + 8` (same) | `rect.right + 8`, but flips to left side if it would overflow viewport | | Vertical clamp | Clamped with 16px margin | Same, preserved | The key fix is aligning `top` to `rect.top` instead of trying to vertically center the popup relative to the element — the old centering formula `rect.top - (popupHeight - rect.height) / 2` was pushing the popup far up or down depending on element position.
When hovering the task the details are shown thousands pixels away... any chance to use a lib or daisyui to show the details when hovering the task?

Looking at the code, the floating popup positioning is using `fixed` positioning with manual calculations that can go wrong. Let me replace the custom hover popup with a DaisyUI `dropdown` approach which handles positioning automatically. ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue ``` ### Changes Summary | Area | Before | After | |---|---|---| | **Hover mechanism** | Custom `fixed` positioning with manual pixel calculations | DaisyUI `dropdown dropdown-right` — browser handles placement | | **State removed** | `isHoveringCompact`, `hoverTimeout`, `floatingTop`, `floatingLeft` | Cleaned up — no longer needed | | **Methods removed** | `handleMouseEnter`, `handleMouseLeave`, `startHoverTimeout`, `beforeUnmount` | All removed | | **Popup trigger** | `@mouseenter` / `@mouseleave` events | DaisyUI `tabindex="0"` focus-based dropdown | | **Popup position** | `fixed` with viewport math that could land anywhere | `dropdown-content` with `ml-2` offset, stays next to the icon | The DaisyUI `dropdown` component uses CSS-based focus/hover to show the panel and automatically positions it relative to its parent element, so it will always appear right next to the sidebar icon.
Split sidebar node in two: Compact and Extended

Looking at the current `ChatSidebarNode.vue`, I'll split it into two separate components: `ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue` and `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue`, then simplify `ChatSidebarNode.vue` to just route between them. ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue ``` ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue ``` ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue ``` ### Summary | File | Role | |---|---| | `ChatSidebarNode.vue` | **Router only** — picks compact or extended based on `isCompact` prop | | `ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue` | Icon-only view with DaisyUI `dropdown dropdown-right` for hover details — no manual positioning math | | `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` | Full expanded view with name, description, actions and recursive children | All hover popup positioning logic (`floatingTop`, `floatingLeft`, `handleMouseEnter`, `hoverTimeout`, etc.) has been removed entirely — DaisyUI's dropdown handles it natively.

files.content:
<script setup>
import ChatSidebarNodeCompact from './ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue'
import ChatSidebarNodeExtended from './ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatSidebarNodeCompact
    v-if="isCompact"
    :chat="chat"
    :allChats="allChats"
    :selectedChatId="selectedChatId"
    @select="$emit('select', $event)"
    @add-subtask="$emit('add-subtask', $event)"
    @delete-chat="$emit('delete-chat', $event)"
  />
  <ChatSidebarNodeExtended
    v-else
    :chat="chat"
    :allChats="allChats"
    :selectedChatId="selectedChatId"
    @select="$emit('select', $event)"
    @add-subtask="$emit('add-subtask', $event)"
    @delete-chat="$emit('delete-chat', $event)"
  />
</template>

<script>
export default {
  props: {
    chat: { type: Object, required: true },
    allChats: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    selectedChatId: { type: String, default: null },
    isCompact: { type: Boolean, default: false }
  },
  emits: ['select', 'add-subtask', 'delete-chat']
}
</script>

Let me update the relevant files: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue ``` Now I need to create the extended node component and add hover behavior to it. Let me check what `ChatSidebarNodeExtended` looks like — since it wasn't provided, I'll create a floating panel for it by adding a `ChatNodeHoverPanel` shared component and updating the extended node. First, let me create a shared hover panel component: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatNodeHoverPanel.vue ``` Now update `ChatSidebarNodeCompact` to use the shared panel: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue ``` Now, since `ChatSidebarNodeExtended` wasn't provided but needs the same hover behavior, I'll create it with the hover panel built in: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue ``` ## Summary of Changes | File | Change | |------|--------| | `ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue` | Replaced `dropdown` approach with CSS `group-hover` floating panel using `left-full` positioning; uses shared `ChatNodeHoverPanel` | | `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` | Added `group-hover` floating panel on the right side + inline action buttons on hover + recursive children rendering | | `ChatNodeHoverPanel.vue` | **New** shared component with chat details (name, description, mode, message count, subtask count, action buttons) | ### Key improvements: - **Both modes** (compact & extended) now show a floating detail panel on hover via `left-full` absolute positioning - Removed DaisyUI `dropdown` from compact node (was click-based, not hover) - Shared `ChatNodeHoverPanel` keeps details consistent between both modes - CSS-only hover (`group`/`group-hover`) — no JS state needed - Panel appears to the **right** of the node in both modes

# 5-Line Summary

1. **Initial Request**: User asked to implement a floating expansion feature for tasks in collapsed sidebar mode, where all tasks are visible as icons but expand on hover.

2. **Solution Design**: Created a two-mode display system where compact mode shows icon-only nodes and expanded mode displays full node content with descriptions and action buttons.

3. **Floating Popup Implementation**: Added a fixed-position floating container in compact mode that appears on hover, displaying full task details, descriptions, message counts, and action buttons (add/delete).

4. **Component Structure**: Modified both `ChatSidebar.vue` and `ChatSidebarNode.vue` to support compact rendering with recursive child nodes visible in the floating popup when expanded.

5. **User Experience**: Implemented smooth hover behavior with timeout delays and nested children support in the floating view, allowing users to navigate task hierarchies without leaving the compact sidebar state.
